requirement.description: {model_monica} proposed automated data contracts. Automated data contracts would ensure the weather feed is always available for the model.
requirement.reading: Automated data contracts would ensure the weather feed is always available for the model.

speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: Automated data contracts are a floor, not a ceiling, so they only guarantee the weather feed arrives on time. I want us to actually monitor for drift in those inputs so the model does not quietly degrade when a heatwave hits.
output.correction: I am not talking about the schema of the file, which is a data engineering concern. I mean the statistical properties of the values, because a perfectly formatted feed with wrong temperatures will still break our forecasts.
